score_objections.objection: Both sources frame AI-driven demand purely as a reason to cut federal regulation and build more generation; no conditions on builders or ratepayer protections are mentioned, only lower prices as a hoped-for outcome. Neither source addresses data centers directly, so evidence is thin, but what exists points to 'Build faster' rather than 'Build with conditions'.
